solution:
names = ["模拟人类智能", "延伸人类能力", "扩展人类边界", "需要人来教"]
values = [1, 2, 3, 4]
threshold = 2

picked = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    if values[i] >= threshold:
        picked.append(names[i])

print(picked)
